_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for GitHub-based tools loaded into the Cursor workspace.
_meta.usage: Add new tools by copying any entry in the 'tools' array. Then run setup-tools.ps1 (Windows) or setup-tools.sh (Bash/WSL).

fields.name: Short unique identifier (kebab-case)
fields.repo: Full GitHub HTTPS URL to clone
fields.description: What this tool provides inside Cursor
fields.installCmd: Shell command run after cloning (cwd is the cloned repo dir)
fields.platform: win | unix | both — which bootstrapper supports this tool
fields.type: cli | skills | plugin | research — how the tool integrates
fields.requiresGpu: Optional boolean — flags tools needing GPU hardware

tools.name: kilo-cli
tools.description: Kilo CLI — agentic engineering platform with 500+ AI models, code generation, and multi-mode agents (Architect, Coder, Debugger).

tools.name: gsd
tools.description: Get Shit Done — meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for Cursor. Installs slash commands into .cursor/commands/gsd/.

tools.name: anthropics-skills
tools.description: Official Anthropic agent skills — folders of instructions and scripts that improve AI performance on specialized tasks (creative, technical, enterprise workflows).
tools.installCmd: echo 'Skills cloned. Copy desired skill folders from .tools-cache/anthropics-skills/skills/ into .cursor/skills/ manually or via the bootstrapper.'

tools.name: autoresearch
tools.description: Karpathy's autonomous ML research agent — modifies code, trains for 5min, checks improvement, repeats. Requires single NVIDIA GPU + Python 3.10+ + uv.

_template._comment: Copy this object into the 'tools' array above, fill in your values, and re-run the bootstrapper.
_template.name: your-tool-name
_template.description: What this tool does inside your Cursor workspace.
